sources.title: Aurora Labs — Brand Intelligence for Growth Teams
sources.text: Aurora Labs is a brand intelligence platform for growth teams. We help marketing leaders understand what their brand truly stands for by combining public web research, documented claims, and structured brand facts in one workspace. Founded in 2021, Aurora Labs is a product-led B2B SaaS company headquartered in Austin, Texas, serving customers across North America and Europe. Our platform crawls public websites, captures verifiable evidence, and turns it into an actionable brand brain that research and marketing teams can review, approve, and reuse. Hundreds of product-led companies rely on Aurora Labs to cut research time from weeks to hours. We practice what we preach: every brand profile is built from cited, human-approved evidence. Aurora Labs offers three plans — Starter, Growth, and Scale — with transparent pricing, a 14-day free trial, and no long-term contracts.

sources.title: About Aurora Labs
sources.text: Aurora Labs was founded in 2021 by a small team of former agency strategists and data engineers who were tired of slow, subjective research. Our mission is to make credible brand research universally available. We are a remote-first team of 35 people spread across North America and Europe. Small and mid-size B2B companies use Aurora Labs to complete buyer and market research for new product launches, rebrands, and go-to-market campaigns. Typical users include fractional CMOs, heads of marketing, and product marketers who need defensible positioning in days, not quarters. Our values are rigor, transparency, and speed. We publish our accuracy metrics and audit our research against source evidence so customers can verify every claim. Aurora Labs is venture-backed and operates as a fully remote company with a distributed engineering team.

sources.title: Pricing — Aurora Labs
sources.text: Aurora Labs pricing is simple and transparent. The Starter plan is $29 per month and includes 1 workspace, 3 brand profiles, and unlimited reviewers. The Growth plan is $79 per month and adds 10 brand profiles, priority research speed, version history, and integrations with Notion and Slack. The Scale plan is $199 per month and includes unlimited brand profiles, dedicated onboarding, SSO, and an API. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and no long-term contracts. All prices are listed in USD and billed monthly or annually. Customers on the Growth and Scale plans get a 20% discount when they choose annual billing. There are no setup fees and no hidden charges; you can cancel at any time.

sources.title: The Fractional CMO's Guide to Faster Brand Research
sources.text: Fractional CMOs are expected to deliver a point of view on the brand within their first two weeks. The fastest way is to work from evidence instead of opinion. This guide is a playbook for researching a brand's website, aggregating claims into themes, and asking the marketing team to confirm what matters before building positioning. We recommend four steps: capture public pages, extract claims with sources, cluster claims into themes, and get one human sign-off per theme. Teams that follow this workflow reduce research time by up to 70% and keep every assertion traceable to a public source. The same evidence-first discipline underpins Aurora Labs' brand intelligence editor, where approved facts drive positioning and go-to-market strategy. Consistency comes from a single source of truth: a brand brain that reflects documented and human-approved claims.

executiveSummary.summary: Aurora Labs should double down on its evidence-first brand intelligence positioning and own the 'brand brain' category it is creating. Over the next 90 days the brand should (1) launch a positioning-first content engine around the fractional CMO playbook, (2) capture high-intent search demand for brand research software, and (3) ship a public evidence credibility report that turns its transparency values into a defensible moat. Core to success is keeping brand facts human-approved and traceable, mirroring the discipline the product enforces for customers. Success is measured against the four quarterly objectives below, anchored in trial starts and strategy-ready brand profiles.
executiveSummary.currentSituation: Aurora Labs is a credible, well-designed product-led B2B SaaS brand with strong positioning raw material: evidence-first research, transparent pricing, and a clear ICP in fractional and in-house marketing leaders. The main gaps are limited category-owning content, thin commercial search coverage, and a messaging system that leans on features more than outcomes.
executiveSummary.strategicDirection: Own 'brand intelligence' for growth teams by packaging research as a human-approved brand brain, publishing the fractional CMO playbook at scale, and proving credibility through a public evidence report.
